title: Musk, Starlink and Ukraine's war
credits: Photos: SpaceX, NASA, Glib Albovsky / Unsplash · Map: Natural Earth
lines: Ukraine says its military's Starlink satellite internet is working again, after more than a week of disruption.
Starlink, run by Elon Musk's SpaceX, is vital for Ukraine's drones, communications and front-line logistics.
Ukrainian commanders reported lost drones and disrupted missions while the restrictions were in place.
Then, Musk said on X that SpaceX had throttled the service.
He said Ukraine's military had violated Starlink's terms of service by using it for offensive drone strikes, and that the loophole was closed last week.
Musk said Starshield, the military version of the system, is controlled by the US government.
President Trump says he did not make the call, and that Musk should not be blamed.
Ukraine's defence minister credited talks with Washington for the restoration.
President Zelensky said: the speeds are now where they need to be.
Meanwhile, Russia, Ukraine and the US are expected to hold new talks in Abu Dhabi in the first half of November.
And both sides say a local ceasefire around Oleshky, in the Kherson region, starts on the twenty-seventh of October.
